sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु वीरेण लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः ।उवाच दीनया वाचा दुःख अभिहत चेतनः ॥३-६१-२५॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu vīreṇa lakṣmaṇena sa rāghavaḥ ।uvāca dīnayā vācā duḥkha abhihata cetanaḥ ॥3-61-25॥

translations.english: Having been addressed thus by Lakshmana, Raghava with a griefstriken heart said these piteous words :' Lakshmana,having spoken like that very affectionately to Rama,who was disturbed by excessive grief said these words piteously:
